title: ArcFlow HTTP shared models
description: Structural JSON schemas. Cross-field/domain and lexical constraints are additionally checked by the source, offline validator and real HTTP tests. x-java-* and x-max-scale document Java wire semantics. This is not a live route.

ActorId.description: Stable live directory ID; RuoYi uses numeric strings. Historical snapshots preserve IDs.

Date.description: Four-digit Java LocalDate calendar date. Quote structural parsing also permits year 0000; initial submission still checks UTC expiry.

Money.description: Exact JSON decimal with BigDecimal scale at most two after applying the exponent; JPY must be numerically whole. No numeric strings.

NonnegativeMoney.description: Exact JSON decimal with BigDecimal scale at most two after applying the exponent; JPY must be numerically whole. No numeric strings.

DisplayMoney.description: Server display string: whole JPY, two decimals otherwise.

QuoteDiscount.description: Requested price is strictly below list price. Source revision, owner, ACL, expiry and snapshot equality are checked by the quote host.

Expense.description: Line IDs and receipt references are each distinct within the request; no cross-request reservation.

Travel.description: End date is not before start; 1–90 days inclusive. No booking or reimbursement side effects.

SealUse.description: Synthetic review only; never applies a seal, signs or fetches the referenced document.

ReceivingLine.description: accepted + rejected = received <= ordered. A positive rejected count requires a nonblank exceptionReason; quantity lexemes cannot be -0.

Receiving.description: At least one line is received. Line IDs/orderLineRef values are separately distinct. Counts of different units are never summed.

PaymentLine.description: previouslySettledAmount <= invoiceAmount; allocationAmount <= invoiceAmount - previouslySettledAmount; deductionAmount <= allocationAmount. Positive deductions require a nonblank reason.

PaymentRequest.description: Net total must be positive. Line IDs and invoice references are each distinct within this request. No payment, balance lock or cross-request reservation.

ContractApproval.description: NONSTANDARD requires a deviation reason; STANDARD requires it blank after trim. Ordered milestone dates lie within the contract term; amounts exactly sum to contractAmount. Line IDs and milestone references are separately unique. No signature or customer delivery.

Decision.description: Same actor/request/stage/action is replayed without a new event; changed comment does not replace history. No actor, revision, expectedRevision or If-Match input.

NativeDecision.description: Native DTO has no Bean Validation. Missing/null stepId reaches domain stage matching (typically 409); the action must still be APPROVE or REJECT. Actor and assignments are server-controlled.

threshold.description: JSON number, normalized through Jackson JsonNode before validation. At most two significant fractional decimal places after trailing-zero normalization, up to 20000000000; JPY is numerically whole. Unlike business-money DTOs, 1.000 is accepted here.

BoundaryNode.description: First node must have id/type start; last id/type end. No runIf or assignees.

ProcessDefinition.description: Ordered nodes, unique IDs, start/end boundaries, 1–8 manual stages. Schema 2 permits only single approval, schema 3 adds ALL/ANY groups, schema 4 adds runIf. Schema 4 is limited to payment/receiving/contract, one predicate family, at most eight atoms overall, one payment currency and at least one unconditional approval. Names/actor IDs cannot contain ISO controls. Participants must be eligible, active and exclude the applicant in the full definition.

Publication.description: expectedVersion and definition.version must equal current version; stable process ID. Success increments version. Publication is not replay-idempotent.

Request.description: Complete immutable business/definition snapshot plus current status/history. business is omitted for legacy submissions; routing is omitted unless schema 4. There is no response revision or detail GET endpoint.

ScenarioView.description: total is null for seal/receiving; other scenarios format their total. summary is present only for receiving, paymentSummary only for payment. Inapplicable summary fields are omitted.

NativeError.description: Controlled ArcFlow advice only. RuoYi authentication/permission failures and unhandled errors are host-owned; their status and body are not promised here.

ScenarioDate.description: Real calendar date in years 0001–9999 for registered scenarios.
